info.title: BBB B2B Aggregator API
info.description: Verified MVP contract for the signed B2B API. All protected endpoints use HMAC headers documented in docs/api/HMAC_AUTHENTICATION.md.

get.summary: Public B2B health check
Public B2B readiness check for runtime dependencies
Prometheus-compatible aggregate B2B metrics
get.description: Exports aggregate service, session, wallet, reconciliation, settlement, provider, and queue metrics without operator identifiers or payload data. Restrict this endpoint at the edge in production.

get.summary: Return signed operator profile and operational counters
Render the signed read-only operator portal page
get.description: Returns an HTML operator portal for the signed operator using the same tenant-scoped, redacted data as /portal/overview.

get.summary: Return a tenant-scoped read-only operator portal overview
get.description: Aggregates signed-operator profile, API key status and public scope names, wallet/session/reporting summaries, recent sessions with portal detail endpoints, recent transactions with portal detail endpoints, settlements, reconciliation items with support-case comment endpoint paths, recent support tickets with message counts, latest redacted message context, and state-aware action endpoint paths, redacted API/audit logs, and safe navigation links. Operator URL fields are returned without query strings. Secret material and raw wallet payloads are never returned.

get.summary: Render one operator game detail page
get.description: Returns a signed text/html game drilldown page for the signed operator only. The page shows game catalog summary, operator assignment, launch availability, successful wallet amounts, and related session and transaction links without launch tokens, raw wallet payloads, or foreign operator records.

get.summary: Render one operator session detail page
get.description: Returns a signed text/html session drilldown page for the signed operator only. The page shows session summary, successful wallet amounts, and related transaction links without launch tokens, launch URLs, raw wallet payloads, or foreign operator records.

get.summary: Render one operator transaction detail page
get.description: Returns a signed text/html transaction drilldown page for the signed operator only. The page shows transaction summary, state transitions, callback attempts, callback logs, reconciliation items, and manual actions without raw request or response payload bodies.

get.summary: Render one operator settlement detail page
get.description: Returns a signed text/html settlement drilldown page for the signed operator only. The page shows settlement summary, totals, transaction breakdown, approval trail, export metadata, and report detail links without export content, raw payload bodies, or foreign operator records.

get.summary: Render one operator provider launch diagnostic page
get.description: Returns a signed text/html provider request diagnostic page for the signed operator only. The page shows provider request status, action, duration, session links, and redacted request/response summaries without launch URLs, launch tokens, raw payload bodies, or foreign operator records.

200.description: Tenant-scoped provider request diagnostic HTML page

get.summary: Return one operator support case detail
get.description: Returns the signed operator's own reconciliation support case with a bounded chronological list of redacted operator-visible comments. Foreign operator cases, raw wallet payloads, and internal backoffice step-up fields are never returned.

get.summary: Render one operator support case thread page
get.description: Returns a signed text/html support case thread page backed by the same tenant-scoped, redacted support case detail payload.

post.summary: Add an operator-visible support comment to an open case
post.description: Appends a signed operator comment to the operator's own open or in-progress reconciliation case. The comment is redacted before persistence, writes a B2B audit event, and never changes wallet state or settlement data.
Creates a tenant-scoped support ticket from the signed operator portal. Subject, message, metadata, and audit reason are redacted before persistence.

get.summary: Return one operator support ticket thread
get.description: Returns the signed operator's own support ticket summary and a bounded chronological list of redacted operator/staff messages. Secret material, foreign operator tickets, and raw payload bodies are never returned.

get.summary: Render one operator support ticket thread page
get.description: Returns a signed text/html support ticket thread page backed by the same tenant-scoped, redacted support ticket thread payload.

post.summary: Add an operator support ticket comment
post.description: Appends a redacted operator message to the signed operator's own open or in-progress support ticket and writes a support_ticket.operator_commented audit event.
Closes the signed operator's own open or in-progress support ticket, stores the redacted close reason, and writes a support_ticket.closed audit event.
Reopens the signed operator's own closed support ticket, stores the redacted reopen reason, clears closed_at, returns the ticket to open, and writes a support_ticket.reopened audit event.

get.summary: Download the signed OpenAPI JSON artifact
get.description: Returns the static OpenAPI contract through the same HMAC and portal.read scope used by the operator portal docs page.

get.summary: Download the signed Postman collection artifact
get.description: Returns the static Postman collection through the same HMAC and portal.read scope used by the operator portal docs page.

get.summary: List games available to the signed operator
get.description: Returns a bounded signed-operator game catalog. Results pass through the same assignment, shop, currency, country, and mode availability checks used by launch. Items include provider_game_id, canonical_game_id, slug, platform, thumbnail_url, launch_config, support limits, status, and metadata.

get.summary: Return one game available to the signed operator
get.description: Returns a single active catalog or legacy Goldsvet game after the same operator assignment, shop, currency, country, and mode checks used by launch. Catalog maintenance returns GAME_UNDER_MAINTENANCE with HTTP 503.

post.summary: Create a B2B game session and return a public launch URL
post.description: Returns the public launch URL only in this create response. Persisted sessions store only the token hash, and session list/detail responses omit token-bearing launch fields.

get.summary: List sessions for the signed operator
get.description: Returns a bounded tenant-scoped session list with validated filters, whitelisted sorting, redacted metadata, and no token-bearing launch fields.

get.summary: Return one operator-owned session and recent wallet transactions
get.description: Returns an operator-owned session with redacted metadata. The response omits token_hash, launch_url, legacy_launch_token, and legacy_launch_url.

post.summary: Close an operator-owned session through the provider close contract

get.summary: Return wallet callback and circuit-breaker health for the signed operator

post.summary: Forward a balance request to the operator wallet

get.summary: Return operator-scoped wallet transaction status and operational history
Return recent callback attempts for an operator-scoped transaction UID
Return operator-scoped transaction summary
get.description: Returns aggregate transaction counts and amounts for the signed operator with validated filters.

get.summary: List wallet transactions for the signed operator
get.description: Returns a bounded tenant-scoped transaction list with validated filters, currency separation, and whitelisted sorting.

get.summary: Return operator-scoped GGR totals
get.description: Returns bet, win, refund, rollback, and GGR totals for the signed operator with validated filters.

get.summary: List settlements for the signed operator
get.description: Returns a bounded tenant-scoped settlement list with validated filters and whitelisted sorting.

post.summary: Generate or return an operator-scoped settlement export snapshot

get.summary: Return one operator-scoped settlement snapshot and lifecycle state
Return operator-scoped reconciliation report
get.description: Returns reconciliation totals, buckets, exposure, and oldest open items for the signed operator with validated filters.

get.summary: Return one operator-scoped wallet transaction with logs and status history

B2BHmac.name: X-Signature
B2BHmac.description: Protected endpoints also require X-Operator-Id, X-Api-Key, X-Timestamp, X-Nonce, and X-Body-Hash. Signature payload is METHOD, path, canonical query, body hash, timestamp, nonce joined by newlines.

post.summary: Forward a wallet mutation to the operator wallet

get.summary: Render a signed read-only operator portal workflow page
get.description: Returns tenant-scoped HTML for credentials, games, sessions, transactions, settlements, cases, callbacks, diagnostics, reports, support, logs, or docs. The credentials page may show public API-key scope names, sessions, transactions, settlements, and provider diagnostics may show portal detail endpoint paths, the support page may show support-ticket message counts and latest redacted message context, the logs page shows redacted operator-owned audit/API events, and operator URL fields are shown without query strings, but secret material and raw wallet/provider payloads are never returned.

get.summary: Return operator-scoped report data
